messages:
Harper (Finance): Heads-up  automated reconciliation flagged a pricing mismatch due to inter-region failover last night. Looks like sustained-use discounts didn’t apply because instances spun up in multiple regions. Delta ~ $24.6k. :rotating_light:
Kevin (Eng-Platform): Oof. Which projects? Could be the failover that moved jobs from us-west1 to europe-west3 during the outage window.
Harper (Finance): Billing extract (simplified):
```
project_id | instance_id | region      | usage_hour | cost
search-prod | gke-7f2 | us-west1 | 2026-11-12T01:00Z | 6200.00
search-prod | gke-7f2 | europe-west3 | 2026-11-12T02:00Z | 6100.00
analytics   | gke-9b8 | us-west1 | 2026-11-12T01:30Z | 6300.00
analytics   | gke-9b8 | europe-west3 | 2026-11-12T03:10Z | 6200.00
```
Lines look like duplicate/migrated instances billed in separate buckets so sustained-use aggregation didn't trigger.
Mina (Eng-ML): That matches the failover timeline I saw. Jobs were evacuated from us-west1 to europe-west3 between 01:15-03:30. We intentionally used cross-region fallback for continuity but didn't consider pricing buckets.
Olaf (CloudOps): We routed compute to EU because of a transient regional scheduler failure. We also created short-lived replacement instances rather than live-migrating, which probably reset the sustained-use counters.
CostBot: Budget "prod-compute" exceeded expected baseline by 145% during failover window. Alert dispatched.
Viv (VendorRelations): If provider sustained-use discounts weren't applied, we can open a billing support case. We should collect raw provider usage export and ask for an invoice adjustment or credit for the continuity migration. I'll need the instance IDs, timestamps, and any migration logs.
Harper (Finance): Proposed remediation plan: 1) Snapshot raw provider export to gs://finance/snapshots/1916001234-provider-raw.csv 2) Run a reconciliation script to identify broken aggregation keys and compute expected sustained-use credits 3) Open vendor support case (ProviderCase: GCP-2026-8231) with evidence and request invoice adjustment 4) Internal attribution: decide whether to backcharge affected teams or absorb centrally while vendor case is open.
Kevin (Eng-Platform): I'll assemble scheduler logs and the failover playbook runbook; will include the trigger event id and the region routing decision. Expect PR for scheduler patch to prefer live-migrate or to set a flag that preserves billing identity.
Mina (Eng-ML): Product impact: search-prod was the critical path. Product wants to decide on absorption vs backcharge. If we backcharge, it should be to the incident response budget not product GA budget.
Harper (Finance): Short-term: finance recommends absorbing to "incident-response" until vendor case resolves, then reallocate if vendor issues credit. We need signoff from Product and Ops.
Viv (VendorRelations): I'll open the support case now and request expedited review. Case: GCP-2026-8231 (link internal once created). Need the snapshot and a short narrative describing cross-region evacuation and why sustained-use should have applied.
Olaf (CloudOps): I'll export migration traces and instance lifecycle events. ETA 2 hours. Also adding a scheduler change to prefer in-region replacements where possible.
CostBot: Note: retroactive tagging won't change provider invoice but will help internal attribution if we need to backcharge later.
Harper (Finance): I'll run a conservative expected-credit calc and post an interim journal entry estimate: $24,600 potential recoverable. Creating ticket FIN-2026-999.
Mina (Eng-ML): Owners: Mina -> confirm impacted jobs and product owner; Kevin -> scheduler fix + logs; Olaf -> migration traces export; Viv -> vendor case + updates; Harper -> snapshot + provisional journal entry. Target: initial update by EOD 2026-11-12.
Kevin (Eng-Platform): Taking action now. Adding a metric to alert if >10% of pool is re-created in another region within 4 hours.
Harper (Finance): Thanks 14 please CC product on vendor case communications. Will follow up with internal memo for month close.
Viv (VendorRelations): Support case opened (GCP-2026-8231) and assigned to billing team. I'll post provider response here when available.
Harper (Finance): Noted. Closing loop for now  will update FIN-2026-999 when we have vendor resolution.
